name: Bunsen Burner
semanticDescription: A standard laboratory Bunsen burner: cast base, vertical stem, adjustable air collar, and brass nozzle. Provides the flame used to heat and ignite the magnesium ribbon.
simplifications: Gas inlet hose and gas tap are omitted; lessons should imply the gas connection verbally if needed.
Air-collar adjustment ring is a static representation; no moving parts are authored yet.
Includes multi-zone Bunsen burner flame with inner reducing core and outer oxidizing mantle.
